description: This file defines base classes and utility functions for handling different data types in pandas-on-Spark, including type casting, comparison operations, and type-specific behavior, within the 'pyspark.pandas.data_type_ops' module.

classes.name: DataTypeOps
classes.description: Base class for data type-specific operations and behaviors in pandas-on-Spark, including type casting, comparison, and arithmetic operation handling.

methods.name: is_valid_operand_for_numeric_arithmetic
methods.description: Checks if an operand is valid for numeric arithmetic operations.

methods.name: transform_boolean_operand_to_numeric
methods.description: Transforms boolean operands to numeric form, handling both IndexOpsMixin objects and boolean literals.

methods.name: _should_return_all_false
methods.description: Determines if comparison should short-circuit to all False based on dtype incompatibility.

methods.name: _as_categorical_type
methods.description: Casts an IndexOpsLike object to a categorical dtype with specified spark type.

methods.name: _as_bool_type
methods.description: Casts an IndexOpsLike object to BooleanType Spark type.

methods.name: _as_string_type
methods.description: Casts an IndexOpsLike object to StringType Spark type, with optional null string handling.

methods.name: _as_other_type
methods.description: Casts an IndexOpsLike object to a specified dtype and spark type, with pre-processing checks.

methods.name: _sanitize_list_like
methods.description: Raises TypeError if operand is list-like.

methods.name: _is_valid_for_logical_operator
methods.description: Checks if a value is valid for logical operations.

methods.name: _is_boolean_type
methods.description: Checks if a value is a boolean type or IndexOpsMixin with BooleanType.

methods.name: _is_extension_dtypes
methods.description: Checks if an object has an extension dtype.
